g.text: A compact wearable designed to monitor your baby’s
daily movement and sleep patterns from birth.
Engineered for newborn sleep, gentle monitoring, and parent peace of mind
Lightweight design for everyday infant comfort
No wired connection or dangerous cords during sleep
Convenient rechargeable design with fast dock
Long-term family product support through toddlerhood
